description:
USER decided PORT (docs/fable-answers-s357.md §3). PROGRESS s358 (commit 5ad7d3a): 11 of 27 files DONE and green through v2 — goto-label-01, local-glob-01, loop-body-context-01, utf8-source-01, loop-labels-01, autoviv-01, local-elem-01/02, local-symref-01, our-local-01, default-underscore-01.

THE RECIPE (validated): replace `Pl::Parser->new(code => $c)` + `->parse` with `Pl::Parser2->parse_code($c)` (returns the CL text; scalar, not a list); change `use Pl::Parser;` / `use_ok('Pl::Parser')` to Pl::Parser2. The scratchpad rewriter handled the three uniform idioms mechanically. THREE LEARNED GOTCHAS: (1) package-SWITCHING runtime tests must transpile via ./pl2cl on a temp file, not parse_code — the bare body's (in-package :main) needs the file entry's (p-defpackage :main) preamble (see our-local-01.t's run_pl); (2) Environment introspection ports as Pl::Parser2->new(code=>...)->parse then ->environment (Parser2 shares the env with its fallback parser — verified has_prototype/get_prototype/get_isa all work); (3) v1-shape like() rows get the v2 spelling of the SAME claim, e.g. box-set → p-my-= (our-local-01 row 2 is the worked example) — never weaken.

REMAINING 16 files (reverted to v1 form at s358 end, still green via the still-present v1 entry): statements-01, eval-01, bless-01, deref-args-01 (had 8 shape fails), constants-01 (3 fails: box-set → p-my-= in the three output_contains constant rows at ~lines 74-90), signatures-01 (done except re-verify; its parse_prototype_or_signature dummy-instance hook STAYS — live v1 seam API, commented), inheritance-01 (27 of 89 shape fails — defclass/ISA vocabulary differences, needs a real pass), magic-vars-01 (25 calls), file-line-01 (25), string-funcs-01 (20), argv-01 (15), prototype-01 (11), errno-01 (8), plus decl-ordering-01, parser-01, use-require-01 (the wider-grep trio — usage not yet surveyed; parser-01 may be a deliberate v1 unit test needing a drop-with-note decision). Port order: mechanical helper files first, inheritance-01 last. When the last ->parse caller is gone: re-run the reachability check, delete v1's file-level chunks (step 3), full gate with per-file row-count deltas explained.
